title: The Lock Call: Saturday, November 28
blurb: The Big Mid debuts with Towson at Penn and Saint Joseph's at Monmouth, Wichita State beats Kentucky in overtime, and a planning commission books New Year's Eve for a golf course.

lines.text: [bright] Wichita State walked into Kentucky and won in overtime.
[grinning] And we found the most mid game in America. Eight picks. Go!
From The Window at Hardwood Bricks, this is Tops and Bottoms, the Lock Call. I'm Brett Busberger.

And I'm Leslie Phyllis. The Washington Post reports a White House official has called a special planning commission meeting for December thirty-first. On the agenda, the president's golf course at East Potomac Park. Days before Democrats take seats on the panel.
[dry] Nobody books New Year's Eve unless the shot clock is running.
[wheezing] I went to a meeting on New Year's Eve once. It was not a meeting.
Today's picks. The under, one fifty-seven and a half, North Florida at Columbia. And Bradley, laying fifteen and a half against Chicago State.
Same game, Merv. The machine has Columbia, laying fourteen and a half. And Cal State Fullerton, laying eleven and a half against Weber State.
The over, one forty-eight, Northern Arizona at Cal State Bakersfield. And Pepperdine, laying nine and a half against Lehigh.
[out of breath] Louisiana, plus seven and a half at home against McNeese. And the over, one thirty-eight and a half. My accountant says stop asking about the freezer. You didn't hear it from me.
[excited] New segment. The Big Mid. The most middle of the road game on the whole board. Last night it was Towson at Penn. Penn was favored by three and a half.
And Towson won by eleven. Seventy-two, sixty-one. Michael Zanoni had twenty-three for Penn and it did not matter. Not very mid, young man.

[delighted] The real story. Wichita State seventy-three, Kentucky seventy-one, in overtime. Dillon Battie's jumper with thirty-six seconds left won it. And Charleston Southern, a nine and a half point dog, beat E T S U behind twenty-seven from Anthony Ruffolo. Memphis got Wake Forest too.
Tonight's Big Mid. Saint Joseph's at Monmouth, seven o'clock Eastern. Saint Joseph's by two and a half, total one forty-seven and a half. Point seven two from dead center.
[conspiratorial] The Big Mid is fixed. I know a guy at the median.
The board. I went two and oh again. Four straight. Twelve, five and one, up five point nine two units. Alone on top.
[grudging] Eleven, six and one. Leslie's eleven and seven. The house split, four and four.
[proud] Six and twelve. Five straight losses. The list is getting long.
That's the Lock Call. The picks column is up now at hardwood bricks dot com.
Twenty-one and up. If gambling's a problem, call one eight hundred GAMBLER.
Keep it mid. Keep it real.

news.item: Washington Post (Dan Diamond, Nov 27, 2026, as reprinted by the Spokesman-Review): "Mark Paoletta, a White House official who leads the National Capital Planning Commission," is holding "a special Dec. 31 meeting" that "would provide the Trump administration an opportunity to quickly finalize approval of the president's planned redevelopment of East Potomac Park's golf course", "days before Democrats take control of Congress and gain seats on the panel." The shot-clock line is the gang's opinion.

notes.board: Standings through Nov 27; yesterday = Nov 27 card (house 4-4, Brett 2-0).
notes.bigmid: From the bigmid block of the Nov 28 facts: last night Towson 72, Penn 61 (Penn by 3.5); upsets Wichita St 73, Kentucky 71 (OT), Charleston So 76, ETSU 67, Memphis 88, Wake Forest 85; tonight Saint Joseph's at Monmouth, 7:00 PM ET, mid 0.72.
